snippet.title: PSX Longplay [015] Rapid Reload
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: xRavenXP

This is the longplay of Rapid Reload game, racing game and 2D gun for Playstation released in Europe and Japan (with the name Gunner's Heaven).

Rapid Reload is known to many today as a spiritual successor to Gunstar Heroes of Mega Drive, for those who do not know, it is a 2D platform game of fast shooting and intense action. Rapid Reload / Gunners Heaven is so much like Gunstar Heroes that you sometimes think it's an indirect continuation of the franchise.

The players choose to play either male or female character Ruka through the game's six levels. The story of the game is that these two characters are in pursuit of a legendary treasure called Valkyrie and are seeking this treasure while fighting against a criminal organization called Pumpkin Heads, who wants the treasure to dominate the world. That is, it's a pretty basic story!

The game controls are good, the graphics are also good, the explosions are intense and each character has four different weapons. Unfortunately the only problem of this game is not having a multiplayer mode! This longplay has improvements in the graphic and sound core and is my first PSX video recorded with Bizhawk. The game was played with both characters. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
